name: Inventory Swap
description: Use the Gadget Button to change item order.

name: Route Planner Bounty
description: When choosing a Travel Ring, get 100 Rings and increase the maximum Ring limit.

name: Less is More
description: Increase the Machine's top speed when holding fewer Rings.

name: Hyper Ring Engine
description: Top-speed boost while holding Rings; drains Rings over time. Physical speed is not a Speed-point bonus.

name: Item Stock Plus
description: Hold up to 3 items instead of 2.

name: Ring Doubler
description: Double the number of Rings gained. Not counted for Team Matches.

name: Ring Engine
description: Top-speed boost while holding Rings; drains Rings over time. Physical speed is not a Speed-point bonus.

name: Ultimate Air Trick
description: Do more than 3 Air Tricks to become invincible for a short time.

name: Perfect Landing
description: Press accelerate as soon as you land to get a speed boost.

name: Substitute Item
description: Taking a homing-item hit loses held items but grants invincibility.

name: Invincible Finish
description: Become invincible when close to the finish line.

name: Collision Evolution
description: Bump into other Machines to change all stats by +1.

name: Ring Evolution
description: Get 10 Rings to change all stats by +1.

name: Damage Evolution
description: Taking damage changes all stats by +7.

name: Item Hit Evolution
description: Land a hit with an item to change all stats by +7.

name: Summon Item Box
description: Spend 40 Rings with the Gadget Button to get an item.

name: Go Go Omochao
description: Omochao distributes Rings for longer and appears more often.

name: Boost Character Kit
description: Accelerate with Air Tricks; Boost characters receive stat adjustments.

name: Power Character Kit
description: Catch up with racers and Boost on collision; Power characters receive stat adjustments.

name: Handling Character Kit
description: Collide with racers and steal Rings; Handling characters receive stat adjustments.

name: Comeback Kit
description: Raise the Ring limit to 110 and gain 2 items on Lap 3.

name: Sea Dog Kit
description: Improve water-form performance and perform Air Tricks much faster.

name: Acceleration Character Kit
description: Catch up with other racers and get Rings; Acceleration characters receive stat adjustments.

name: Ace Pilot Kit
description: Improve flight-form performance and gain Rings from Dash Panels and Gates.

name: All-Rounder Kit
description: Reduce deceleration-area and slippery-road effects and greatly improve water and flight stats.

name: Wisp Hoarder Kit
description: Use many Wisp items and gain items when completing laps.

name: Speed Character Kit
description: Become invincible at the start and get Rings from a successful Starting Boost; Speed characters receive stat adjustments.

name: Item Buster Kit
description: Make Attack items more common and get Rings for attacking racers.

name: Drift Spinner Kit
description: Fill Level 1 Drift Charge slightly faster and knock away Machines while drifting.

name: Panel Combo Kit
description: Passive Handling and Power bonuses; consecutive Dash Panels separately grant Rings.

name: Starting Boost Bounty
description: Get Rings with a successful Starting Boost.

name: 130 Ring Limit
description: Hold up to 130 Rings.

name: Collision Boost
description: Collide with a Machine to Boost.

name: Extended Slipstream
description: Make slipstreams occur more often.

name: Ring Thief
description: Steal Rings when colliding with other Machines.

name: Mini Ring Thief
description: Steal a small amount of Rings when colliding with other Machines.

name: Quick Recovery
description: Recover from attacks faster.

name: Acceleration Machine Kit
description: Reduce the impact of damage; Acceleration Machines receive stat adjustments.

name: Wisp Chance UP
description: Wisp items appear more often.

name: Invincible Start
description: Become invincible for a short time when the race starts.

name: Handling Machine Kit
description: Become invincible with Charge Level 4 Boosts; Handling Machines receive stat adjustments.

name: Power Machine Kit
description: Boost when colliding with other Machines; Power Machines receive stat adjustments.

name: Spin Drift
description: While drifting, spin at high speed and knock away other Machines.

name: Crash Pads
description: Halve the number of Rings lost when taking damage.

name: Warp Ring Specialist
description: Start with a Warp Ring; Warp Rings can also appear in Item Boxes.

name: Item Keeper
description: Prevent items from being dropped.

name: Perfect Charge Boost
description: Release the drift as soon as a Charge Level fills to Boost faster.

name: Friction Drift
description: Slow down while drifting in land form, but charge the Drift Gauge much faster.

name: Quick Starter
description: Gain +20 to all stats during Lap 1.

name: Slow Starter
description: Gain +20 to all stats during Lap 3.

name: Super Quick Starter
description: Gain +60 to all stats during Lap 1.

name: Super Slow Starter
description: Gain +60 to all stats during Lap 3.

name: Speed Machine Kit
description: Get more Rings and accelerate with them; Speed Machines receive stat adjustments.

name: Drift Charge Kit
description: Fill the Drift Gauge faster and slightly improve Handling.

name: Spin Dash Kit
description: Change drift charging to repeated acceleration presses; charges build slower but last longer.

name: Speed Tuner 1
description: Adjust Speed; matching Speed machines also receive an Acceleration penalty.

name: Speed Tuner 2
description: Adjust Speed; matching Speed machines also receive Acceleration and Boost penalties.

name: Acceleration Tuner 1
description: Adjust Acceleration; matching Acceleration machines also receive a Handling penalty.

name: Acceleration Tuner 2
description: Adjust Acceleration; matching Acceleration machines also receive Handling and Boost penalties.

name: Handling Tuner 1
description: Adjust Handling; matching Handling machines also receive a Power penalty.

name: Handling Tuner 2
description: Adjust Handling; matching Handling machines also receive Speed and Power penalties.

name: Power Tuner 1
description: Adjust Power; matching Power machines also receive an Acceleration penalty.

name: Power Tuner 2
description: Adjust Power; matching Power machines also receive Acceleration and Handling penalties.

name: Boost Tuner 1
description: Adjust Boost; matching Boost machines also receive a Speed penalty.

name: Boost Tuner 2
description: Adjust Boost; matching Boost machines also receive Speed and Power penalties.

name: Boost Machine Kit
description: Matching Boost machines gain Boost stat points; drift boosts can grant rings.

name: Attack Item Chance UP
description: Attack items appear more often.

name: Defense Item Chance UP
description: Defense items appear more often.

name: Lucky Pair
description: Occasionally get double items.

name: Boost Item Chance UP
description: Boost items appear more often.

name: Damage Mercy
description: Become temporarily invincible after taking damage.

name: Strong Finish
description: Become temporarily invincible on Lap 3.

name: Hazard Item Chance UP
description: Hazard items appear more often.

name: Champion Bounty
description: Get Rings while in 1st through 3rd place.

name: Ring Mercy
description: Get Rings after taking damage.

name: Giant Rocket Punch
description: Rocket Punch becomes bigger and appears more often.

name: Item Mercy
description: Get an item after taking damage.

name: Double Down
description: Debuff all stats, but always get double items.

name: Ultimate Charge
description: Add a fourth Drift Charge level and become invincible during its boost.
